summary.result: Experimental results show that each polarimetric radar observable conveys different information on permafrost environments.
summary.background: The permafrost active layer plays an important role in permafrost dynamics.
summary.method: In the case of the dual-pol mode, the radar observables consist of two backscattering powers and one correlation coefficient between polarimetric channels.
